title: Postgraduate Fellowships Abroad
field: Postgraduate studies (master's or doctoral), all disciplines except MBA
about: The "la Caixa" Foundation's 2027 Postgraduate Fellowships Abroad call is for Spanish and Portuguese students pursuing full-time master's or doctoral studies in the EHEA, North America or Asia-Pacific. Applications are due 21 January 2027 at 14:00 mainland Spain time.
requirements: Spanish and Portuguese students (per the call page)
Full-time, attendance-based master's or doctoral studies starting with the fellowship; MBA programmes excluded
Application entirely in English with at least three reference letters

upskill.name: the full course catalog
why: The call is open to all disciplines except MBA and its stated requirements (nationality, full-time study, English application with three reference letters) are not covered by any course objective; shortlist matches were keyword noise ("student"), so the link points to the Academy course catalog, not a specific course.

card_alt: Card for the Postgraduate Fellowships Abroad of the "la Caixa" Foundation, deadline 21 Jan 2027. The photo is a generic default image, an aerial view of a city skyline with a tall tower beside a winding river at sunset; it does not show the study location.
